track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 14: Hesar
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Hesar in Chahargah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Cs3 and dwells most on E in Hesar. The line peaks at Fs4 (359.3 Hz) at 0:26.9. It closes on the tonic (E3 → E3 → D4 → D4 → D4 → D4).
